Some days, 40% is still showing up.
Some doors close so you'll finally look up.
Some doors don't close. They just wait for you to walk through.
Some doors open when we bow our heads.
Some endings / are just love / changing address.
Some friends are for a season. Be grateful anyway.
Some friends are the bridge over the hardest years.
Some friendships / are a long talk on a bench.
Some friendships don't age. They just get better stories.
Some goodbyes are an act of love.
Some goodbyes make room for better hellos.
Some joys never grow up.
Some people / feel like a warm blanket / in human form.
Some people are bridges. Thank them as you cross.
Some people are home, / no matter the address.
Some people are worth every mile it takes to see them.
Some people become places you can only visit in your heart.
Some places feel like I've been there before.
Some places feel like a deep breath.
Some places stay with you / long after you leave.
Some places were made for holding hands.
Some prayers are just a sigh.
Some sights make you whisper thank you.
Some skies are moody. / They're still beautiful.
Some songs / are just doors / to old rooms.
Some souls recognise each other instantly.
Some streets ask you to slow down. Listen.
Some summers / never really end.
Some things aren't problems to fix. They're weather to wait out.
Some things change. / Let them.
Some trains aren't yours to catch.
Some views ask nothing but to be noticed.
Some views feel like coming home.
Something good / is about to begin.
Something good / is already on its way up.
Something good / is humming under the surface.
Somewhere / a road / is waiting for you.
Somewhere, a light is on for you.
Somewhere, someone is glad / you exist.
Sorrow is what love feels like when it has lost its place to land.
Spend time with yourself. You're good company.
Spend your time like it reflects what you love.
Stand at the edge of something big. Your worries get smaller.
Stand at the edge of what scares you. Then breathe.
Stand still and let it be big.
Stand tall in your own slow time.
Standing alone is not the same as lonely.
Start the trail before you feel brave.
Stay a little longer. Some places deserve it.
Stay a student of life.
Stay sweet. The world has enough bitterness.
Still water, honest reflection.
Stop reading old messages. The answer isn't in there.
Strength is often quiet and upright.
Strong walls are built stone by stone.
Success is quiet. / It looks like showing up again.
Success looked quieter than I thought. It looked like peace.
Take the long way. It's usually the pretty one.
Take the road you'll want to tell stories about.
Take the small streets. That's where a city tells you its secrets.
Take up space. The room is big enough for you.
Take yourself out for coffee. / You’re good company.
Tall trees were small for a long time.
Tend what you have and watch it grow.
Tend your spark. Small flames still warm a room.
Thank the day before it goes.
Thank the ones / who held your hand / and never mentioned it.
Thank the person you used to be, then let them rest.
Thank you for today. It was enough.
Thank you, / little version of me / who got me here.
Thank you, sunshine. Thank you, rest.
The anniversary will come. Plan something soft.
The best memories / smell like something specific.
The best old days / are still being made.
The best part / is not knowing how it ends.
The best road trips are mostly the people in the car.
The best souvenirs don't fit in a suitcase.
The best view is still the one beside me.
The blossoms don't mind that they don't last.
The bridge was still there when the fog lifted.
The comeback is always stronger than the setback.
The countdown / is half the fun.
The first step is never pretty. / Take it anyway.
The fullest branches bend the lowest.
The hardest years write the best chapters.
The heart heals / when the hands let go.
The horizon never comes closer. Enjoy the water anyway.
The house was small. / The memories were not.
The leaves fall so the tree can rest.
The lesson comes back until you listen.
The light always comes back first to the water.
The little moments / are the big moments.
The map is / an invitation.
The mountain doesn't rush to be tall.
The mountain was there even on the cloudy days.
The night is not the end of the story. It's where stars show up.
The old dream can become a new one.
The ones we lose stay in the way we love.
The ones who stay / for the boring parts / are the keepers.
The past is a place / you visit, not live in.
The quiet days of practice build the loud days of progress.
The quiet isn't empty. / It's just waiting for you to hum.
The right love makes you softer, not smaller.
The right people / are still on their way.
The right people make your soul feel rested.
The right person feels / like coming home.
The river didn't fight the rock. It went around, and made something beautiful.
The road bends. So can you.
The rock doesn't fight the sea. It simply stays.
The sea keeps nothing / it wasn't meant to hold.
The storm in your head / is not the weather outside.
The sun always finds its way back.
The sun doesn't cling to the day.
The tide goes out so the shore can breathe.
The trees let go every autumn and still come back green.
The truest love I know grew old together.
The tunnel is real. So is the light.
The view is worth / every step it took.
The world is wide / and kind enough / to meet you.
The world is wide. / Your heart can be too.
Their blessing didn't take yours away.
There is always something / to be thankful for. Look again.
There is no deadline for missing someone.
There is still so much good in the world.
There's always a window somewhere.
There's light / at the end of every road.
Things can get better, even if you can't see how yet.
This is the part / you’ll tell stories about.
This isn't the life I planned. It can still be a good one.
This moment won't come back. / Be here for it.
This, right here. This is enough.
Time carved this slowly. Be patient with yourself too.
Time isn't against you. / It's carrying you.
Time shaped these walls. It's shaping you too.
Tired hearts raise brave children. You are seen.
Today feels / like the first page of something.
Today feels like / the first page of a good book.
Today only needs / today's strength.
Today's awkward effort / is tomorrow's ease.
Today, I'm thankful / for the simple things.
Tomorrow is a blank page. Write something kind.
Tomorrow is a new road. / You don't have to see all of it.
Tonight, / be your own good company.
Toss a coin. Make a wish. Come back someday.
Trains don't go backward for passengers who missed them.
Travel far enough / to meet yourself.
True friends clap loudest when you win.
True love doesn't complete you. It keeps you company.
True love is choosing each other on ordinary days.
True love tells you the truth, gently.
Trust grows slowly, like roots you never see.
Trust the seasons. Spring always returns.
Try again. / This time, wiser.
Turn down the little street. You never know.
Turn the page. / The story isn't over.
Turn toward the light. / Plants know what they're doing.
Unclench your hands. You can't catch the wind.
Uneven roads still get you home.
Unpack what was never yours to carry.
Up here, the worries look tiny.
Ups and downs are part of the ride.
Use the good plates on a Wednesday.
Visit the past. / Don't move in.
Visit the past. Just don't move back in.
Walk among trees / until the noise falls away.
Walk away from what keeps you small.
Walk beside me even where the path disappears.
Walk forward. / The sunrise is that way.
Walk slower in new places. They're telling you something.
Walk slower. / We're not in a hurry. / We're together.
Walk through the gate. Leave the rest behind.
Walk to the end and let the wind take it.
Walk with friends who make the long way short.
Walking away can be the bravest step forward.
Walls are for climbing or for leaning on.
Wander slowly. Gardens don't like to be rushed.
Warm lights, slow steps, nowhere to be.
Waves break. The rock stays. You can be both.
We are all collections of where we've been.
We didn't fall in love. / We walked into it, slowly.
We didn't know / it was the good old days / while we were in them.
What happened, happened. / What's next is still yours.
What if it all / works out?
What's meant for you / won't pass you by.
Where the road goes, the stories follow.
Wide open spaces make room to breathe.
Winter isn't wasted. It's where roots grow.
Worries look bigger at night. / Let the morning decide.
Worry pretends / to be preparation. / It isn't.
Write the letter. / Someone needs to hear from you.
You are allowed / to be a work in progress / and a masterpiece.
You are allowed to be / a work in progress.
You are allowed to love yourself before you're finished.
You are becoming who you needed when you were younger.
You are held, even when you feel alone.
You are not behind. / You're in bloom, / just not yet visible.
You are not for everyone. And that's okay.
You are not too much. / You’re just waiting for your people.
You are somebody's / favourite person / to hear from.
You can forgive / and still choose distance.
You can love someone and still let them go.
You can mean well and still need to say sorry.
You can miss it and still not go back.
You can miss people / and still enjoy your own company.
You can stand alone and still be whole.
You can start over as many times as you need.
You can't steer a boat that never leaves the dock.
You climbed for this. Take it all in.
You don't have to / be okay by Friday.
You don't have to / outrun the rain. / Just keep a little cover.
You don't have to / solve it tonight.
You don't have to be loud to be sure of yourself.
You don't have to be who you were last year.
You don't have to bloom on anyone else's schedule.
You don't have to look back / to know how far you've come.
You don't have to see far. / Just far enough.
You don't have to see the other side to start crossing.
You don't have to see the top to trust it's there.
You don't have to see the whole road. Just the next mile.
You don't have to stand out to matter.
You don't need a reason / to stop and look up.
You don't need many. / You need real.
You don't need perfect soil to bloom.
You don't need the whole path. / Just the next step.
You don't need the whole plan. Just the next page.
You don’t have to know the whole road. / Just the next turn.
You loved fully. / Nothing to be ashamed of.
You only lose if you stop trying.
You were allowed to not know better.
You were never behind. / You were becoming.
You will love again. Differently, but truly.
You're allowed to be altered by the places you've been.
You're not behind. / You're on your own path.
You're not moving on. You're moving forward, with them.
You've survived / every bad day so far. / That's a good record.
You've survived every hard day so far.
You've waited long enough. / It's time.
Your future self is grateful for what you do today.
Your heart knows / before your plans do.
Your mind is loud / because it cares. / Be gentle with it.
Your mind is loud today. / Be gentle with it anyway.
Your pace / is still progress.
Your pace is not wrong. It's yours.
Your passion doesn't need an audience to be worth it.
Your roots are not your cage.
Your soulmate might be your best friend all along.
Your time is the most precious gift.
Your worth isn’t measured / by how much you got done.
Your worth was never tied to the outcome.
You’re allowed to rest / before everything is solved.
You’ve survived every hard day so far. / Today is no different.
Zoom out. It's never as big as it feels.
“Hope” is the thing with feathers / That perches in the soul
Weeping may endure for a night, / but joy cometh in the morning.
Although the world is full of suffering, / it is full also of the overcoming of it.
Isn’t it nice to think that tomorrow is a new day / with no mistakes in it yet?
They shall mount up with wings as eagles; / they shall run, and not be weary.
I dwell in Possibility –
We are all in the gutter, / but some of us are looking at the stars.
Give sorrow words: the grief that does not speak / whispers the o’er-fraught heart and bids it break.
’Tis better to have loved and lost / than never to have loved at all.
Your pain is the breaking of the shell / that encloses your understanding.
I have been bent and broken, / but — I hope — into a better shape.
You pierce my soul. / I am half agony, half hope.
What’s done cannot be undone.
Write it on your heart / that every day is the best day in the year.
Very little is needed / to make a happy life.
I’m so glad I live in a world / where there are Octobers.
A merry heart / doeth good like a medicine.
The earth laughs in flowers.
That it will never come again / is what makes life so sweet.
I would always rather be happy / than dignified.
Whatever our souls are made of, / his and mine are the same.
The course of true love / never did run smooth.
My bounty is as boundless as the sea, / my love as deep.
Love is not love / which alters when it alteration finds.
And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; / but the greatest of these is charity.
There is no charm equal / to tenderness of heart.
Shall I compare thee / to a summer’s day?
Take therefore no thought for the morrow.
Heaven is under our feet / as well as over our heads.
Nothing can bring you peace / but yourself.
Come forth into the light of things, / let Nature be your teacher.
And forget not that the earth delights to feel your bare feet / and the winds long to play with your hair.
To every thing there is a season, / and a time to every purpose under the heaven.
I’m not afraid of storms, / for I’m learning how to sail my ship.
Though she be but little, / she is fierce.
Our doubts are traitors, / and make us lose the good we oft might win / by fearing to attempt.
I am no bird; and no net ensnares me.
Be not afraid of greatness.
Well done is better than well said.
Why, sometimes I’ve believed as many as / six impossible things before breakfast.
The mountains are calling / and I must go.
I travel not to go anywhere, but to go. / I travel for travel’s sake.
Afoot and light-hearted / I take to the open road.
In every walk with nature / one receives far more than he seeks.
The journey of a thousand li / commences with a single step.
quotes.work: Tao Te Ching, tr. James Legge

quotes.q: Two roads diverged in a wood, and I — / I took the one less traveled by.
It’s no use going back to yesterday, / because I was a different person then.
Think only of the past / as its remembrance gives you pleasure.
Nothing gold can stay.
There is nothing either good or bad, / but thinking makes it so.
While we are postponing, / life speeds by.
I went to the woods because / I wished to live deliberately.
To live is the rarest thing in the world. / Most people exist, that is all.
quotes.work: The Soul of Man under Socialism

quotes.q: This above all: / to thine own self be true.
I am large, / I contain multitudes.
Forever – is composed of Nows –
A thing of beauty / is a joy for ever.
Work is love made visible.
Kindred spirits are not so scarce / as I used to think.
What do we live for, if it is not / to make life less difficult to each other?
Love all, trust a few, / do wrong to none.
I will honour Christmas in my heart, / and try to keep it all the year.
Be still, / and know that I am God.
Adopt the pace of nature: / her secret is patience.
Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, / and I will give you rest.
Simplify, simplify.
We suffer more often / in imagination than in reality.
Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; / they toil not, neither do they spin.
All shall be well, and all shall be well, / and all manner of thing shall be well.
I wandered lonely as a cloud
I never found the companion / that was so companionable as solitude.
The Soul selects her own Society –
I am the master of my fate, / I am the captain of my soul.
Our remedies oft in ourselves do lie.
My heart leaps up when I behold / A rainbow in the sky
O frabjous day! / Callooh! Callay!
This is the day which the Lord hath made; / we will rejoice and be glad in it.
Though nothing can bring back the hour / of splendour in the grass, of glory in the flower
Remember me when I am gone away
Should auld acquaintance be forgot, / and never brought to mind?
It was the best of times, / it was the worst of times.
